title: feat(alerts): move the filters onto the shared filter panels

frontend/src/sections/projects/LLMTracin: // A property may narrow its own operators — e.g. span type, where the API
// takes a value list and has nowhere to put an operator, so anything but
// "is one of" would be a no-op or an inversion.
// A property whose declared operators share nothing with its type would
// narrow the row down to an empty dropdown, so fall back to the type's own.
// When the row owns its type, swapping the property must not reset it —
// the type is the user's choice, not a fact about the field.
[index, filter, selectedProp, safeOperator, isNumber, isDate, onChange],
frontend/src/sections/projects/Alerts/co: // FilterPanel `filterFields` for the issues table. `choices` hold the values
// the API expects; `choiceLabels` map them to what the user sees.

note: The design doc predicted UPDATE-EXISTING via OBS-E2E-002's data-filter-* selectors. `gh pr diff 2182 | grep data-filter` returns nothing and a probe of the complete 22-file diff against the live pinned index produced zero hits, so the deciding signal is the feat title in `alerts`, an area with no flows — NEW-FLOW. addedLines carry the verbatim added lines of the two behaviour files in the areas at issue; the remaining files are FE tests and further Alerts components.
